milestones.title: Windows BugHunter scanner — 91 findings on Ken's box
milestones.summary: Read-only scanner.js (532 lines) ran on DESKTOP-ED797OH in 15.4s. Surfaced 65 HIGH (unquoted services, writable PATH dirs, hijackable scheduled tasks), 25 MEDIUM (ports bound to 0.0.0.0), 1 LOW (WSH enabled), 6 INFO. Highlighted finding: Ubisoft UpcElevationService unquoted ImagePath (CVSS 7.8). Defender + firewall both green. Report archived at kenos/bughunter/sample-report.md.

milestones.title: Four bounty packets drafted — Nexon (CRIT 8.4) / Epic (CRIT 9.3) / Ubisoft (HIGH 7.8) / Google (HIGH 7.8)
milestones.summary: Vendor-ready submission markdown: Nexon NGS unquoted-path-with-writable-parent (any local user → SYSTEM, no admin needed); Epic EpicGamesUpdater service-binary + 55 DLLs writable by local user (DLL hijack to SYSTEM); Ubisoft UpcElevationService unquoted ImagePath (LPE chain); Google Play Games Services unquoted auto-start service (LPE on every boot). Each packet includes CVSS vector, repro steps, PoC notes, remediation, environment context. Estimated payout floor $10K / ceiling $120K across the four packets.

Target MSRC Azure Bounty ($60K cap) for any service-side issue found during sandbox testing. Phase 3: AWS + GCP + Linux on-host modules; productize as scanner-as-a-service tied to the KenOS package model.
